first_public_date_evidence: https://portal.mardi4nfdi.de/wiki/Publication:2360538 identifies 4 July 2017; a later arXiv rendering dated 8 April 2020 gives the openly readable full text
integrity: The qualitative Sarason boundedness criterion, the generalized Fock kernel and the Gaussian operator norm are published prior results and are explicitly credited. Finite tests are illustrative, not a proof of the asymptotic result. Publication priority and independent validation remain open.
scientific_limitations: Only the equal-radius normalized two-coherent matrix coefficient is classified for fixed m>1/2 and integer 1<=d<2m; not a formula for the general operator norm. The case m<=1/2, borderline d=2m and general singular-value estimates are not addressed; historical equivalence may be unindexed.
title: Sharp equal-radius coherent-state amplification for reciprocal exponential Fock Toeplitz products
